text:
alex: Hey team — I pushed changes to PR #432: fixed the KV allocator rotation bug that could lead to an extra free on hot paths, added a focused unit + integration test, and updated the changelog. Could someone take a quick pass? I need two approvals to land and I'd like to target the Friday 10:00 PST merge slot so the canary can run immediately after.

maya: Thanks. Quick skim now, prioritize the error strings + test names.

jon: Looking as well. Do you have perf numbers for the common-case? Curious about any tail-latency impact.

alex: Short numbers in the perf gist: https://go/reports/pr-432-perf — median token latency ~12ms -> 10.8ms, p95 28ms -> 25ms. No regression on throughput in our CI harness.

maya: Found a nit in the error handling commit: the message "allocator rotation failed" is a little vague for debugging. Can you include the rotation id and current head pointer in the string?

alex: Good call. Updated the message and pushed a follow-up commit. Also rebased out the experimental logging commit that was only for my local debugging. I intend to squash when merging so the history stays clean for canary.

sam: Tests pass locally for me. Quick note: the integration test takes ~45s; can we move it to flaky CI stage or keep it in the fast suite?

alex: Left it in integration CI (longer window). I added a small unit that covers the fast path; the longer test asserts the full rotation/fallback behavior. If maintainers prefer I can mark the long test with @slow.

jon: One more question about fallback: does this change adjust when we fall back to CPU kernels? I don't want surprise regressions in `fallback_policy` routing.

alex: No behavioral change to routing. This is purely allocator correctness (memory accounting and rotation). I added `test_fallback_after_rotation` to assert fallback still triggers on out-of-memory simulated path.

ops-bot: CI: unit/integration passed on branch; e2e queued.

maya: Approving once e2e passes. :rocket:

sam: LGTM — will approve after the error string commit is in.

jon: I will give a +1 after CI green. One small doc nit request: can you add a short comment in runtime/allocator explaining the rotation invariants? saves future head-scratching.

alex: Done, added a short comment block and linked the perf gist in the PR description.

ops-bot: E2E passed on branch.

oncall: Noted — we'll watch the canary after merge.

maya: Approved.

sam: Approved.

jon: Approved.

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll squash+merge into main and schedule for the Friday 10:00 PST slot. I'll post a heads-up in #incidents if anything noisy shows in canary.
